heroTitle: A local lead funnel for security cameras, access control, and fire protection installs.
heroSubtitle: This preview replaces a passive Contact Us page with clear packages, instant next steps, and a local SEO/ad engine.

sections.title: Stop sending paid traffic to a dead-end contact page.
sections.body: The upgraded page can show 3, 5, and 7 camera packages, instant price ranges, FAQs, trust signals, and a request-a-quote path that turns visitors into qualified leads.

sections.title: Rank for the exact searches buyers are already making.
sections.body: Security camera installer near me, access control installation, commercial fire protection, and local service keywords can be organized into a stronger search structure.

sections.title: Launch Facebook campaigns only after the funnel can convert.
sections.body: Once the funnel is live, ad spend has somewhere useful to go. Campaigns can be tracked by offer, package, lead source, and cost per qualified inquiry.

testimonial: We do not just run ads. We build the system that makes ads work.
